answered.sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Film AS T1 JOIN Movie_Elements AS T2 ON T1.title = T2.movie_title WHERE T2.composer_id = 1 AND (T2.element_type = 'Sound Design' OR T2.element_type = 'Music Score')

candidates.meaning: Find films where both sound design and music score are composed by John Williams.
candidates.sql: SELECT title FROM Film WHERE id IN (SELECT movie_title FROM Movie_Elements WHERE composer_id = 1 AND element_type = 'Sound Design') AND id IN (SELECT movie_title FROM Movie_Elements WHERE composer_id = 1 AND element_type = 'Music Score')

candidates.meaning: Films where the sound design and music score were both composed by John Williams.
candidates.sql: SELECT title FROM Film WHERE id IN (SELECT movie_title FROM Movie_Elements WHERE composer_id = (SELECT id FROM Composer WHERE creator = 'John Williams' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Movie_Elements WHERE movie_title = Film.title AND composer_id = (SELECT id FROM Composer WHERE creator = 'John Williams')) >= 2)

candidates.meaning: Films where either the sound design or the music score was composed by John Williams.
